customers.evidence: We work to make technology accessible to everyone, and our business model is ads so our services can be free.

environment.evidence: To be supported by 100% renewable energy

community.evidence: Give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together.

shareholders.evidence: Use our apps to connect with customers and grow

safety.evidence: We have a responsibility to promote the best of what people can do together by keeping people safe and preventing harm.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational mission framing led by connection and community, using first-person plural 'our' and absolute phrasing such as 'We work to' and 'We have a responsibility'. Principles lead with user voice and connection; safety and access appear secondary. Business scale claims and a long product-launch timeline are factual description. No workforce, DEI or ethics commitments appear.
